description: This file defines the 'Edit' feature for articles in the application, including a command handler that updates article data and tags in the database.

classes.name: Edit.ArticleData
classes.description: Record type representing the data for an article, including optional title, description, body, and tags.

classes.name: Edit.Command
classes.description: Request object encapsulating the article model and slug for editing an article.

classes.name: Edit.Model
classes.description: Wrapper for the ArticleData, used within the Command.

classes.name: Edit.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the Command, ensuring the article data is not null.

classes.name: Edit.Handler
classes.description: Handles the editing process: fetches the article, updates fields, manages tags, and persists changes.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the edit command: retrieves the article, updates properties, manages tags, and saves changes.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToCreate
methods.description: Determines which tags need to be added to the article.

methods.name: GetArticleTagsToDelete
methods.description: Determines which tags need to be removed from the article.
